theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_ic_linear_mobius_derivative
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (F : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (P : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (τ : UpperHalfPlane), (∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.coeff d (F (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)).val) (MvPolynomial.coeff d P.val) ((σ • τ : UpperHalfPlane) : ℂ)) → ∀ e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.coeff e (A (F (σ • UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z))).val) (MvPolynomial.coeff e (A P).val / (HeckeEis.jFactor σ τ) ^ 2) (τ : ℂ)
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the accepted linear-coefficient derivative transport and scalar Möbius pullback theorems.
